boundary_path.evidence: The module loads JS URLs from the domain scan's JS URL list, downloads each response body, and passes the body into extractEndpoints.
The URL/href assignment RE2 expression captures group 1 using [^"'\x60\s]{4,200}.
extractEndpoints trims and filters each capture, then returns it to the caller.
Returned endpoint strings are written to the JS endpoint text file and structured dashboard findings.
The project describes JavaScript scanning as extracting API endpoints and authentication-related material from JavaScript files.

review_scope: URL-assignment capture delimiters only; the proof does not establish endpoint validity, in-scope status, or completeness.
